title: Block Git Commands in Script Interpreters
summary: Created `nakgin-capsule-tower.diff.design.semio.json` — a comprehensive design diff for the Nakagin Capsule Tower with 5 operations: (1) Remove the last storey (f10 tambour + 8 capsules + capital) from the larger tower (c1), removing 10 pieces and 10 connections. (2) Reconnect a new capital piece to tambour f9 of c1. (3) Add a new base with a tambour on top and one capsule, with connecting connections. (4) Update all 7 capsules in the third storey (f2) of the smaller tower (c0) with renovated descriptions. (5) Replace capsule cs_sl0_d2_t_f4_b_c0 with a bridge in the fifth storey. Exported from `@semio/assets` as `NakginCapsuleTowerDiffDesign`. Added NakginDiff stories to Diagram, Scene, and Design storybook files.
